attr.title: Titanic: Adventure Out of Time
attr.desc: Godot player for the original game. Supply your own cd1/cd2 ISOs, GOG/Steam files or extracted discs. Optional M3tox mods are supported.
attr.inst: Drop both cd1 and cd2 ISOs into ports/titanic. GOG/Steam files with LOCAL or extracted discs also work in gamedata. See README.txt. Left stick moves and selects dialogue; A confirms; B goes back; right stick controls the pointer; L1 slows it; L2/R2 cycle targets; Start opens the menu. Download patches on first start or select their FULL ZIP.
